name: io.github.robd-hub/cheap-first
title: Cheap First
description: Answers cheaply first, then escalates to a premium model only when a checker fails.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional prepaid key as Bearer cf_... for paid limits. Leave empty for the free demo.

headers.name: X-Cheap-First-Paid
headers.description: Set to 1 to request the x402 payment challenge ($0.005 USDC on Base) instead of the free demo.
